{{Quote|Your planet—your home—is being drowned in blood! For three thousand years we were loyal to the Republic…the Republic has ignored our cries for help—until they learned that beneath all the mud—our planet has a heart of ore!|Alto Stratus|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
'''Jabiim''' {{Pronounced|dʒə'bi:m}}, known as '''Gwynhes Minor''' during the reign of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], was a small, muddy, [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was most notably the site of three fierce [[Battle of Jabiim|Battles of Jabiim]].

==Description==
===Astrography and atmosphere===
Jabiim was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Jabiim system/Legends|Jabiim system]],<ref name="EAWGG" /> a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Jabiim" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Jabiim (star)|Jabiim]] and was 10,700 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter.<ref name="EAWGG" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Handooine system/Legends|Handooine]] and [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene systems]] as well as the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]] of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]].<ref name="Triellus" /> In particular, Jabiim was located only a short [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump away from the planet [[Handooine/Legends|Handooine]].<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" />

Jabiim possessed an ionized<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was well-suited for [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Republic 55" /> but made high-altitude [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles impossible to operate.<ref name="GaW" /> Electrically-charged atmospheric disturbances<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> hampered long-range orbital scanning<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> and limited visibility,<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> and also prevented the use of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] air support<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> which could only land or disembark during very narrow and unpredictable windows of time.<ref name="FF 119">{{FactFile|119|ANA 29-30|Anakin Skywalker}}</ref>

The planet had a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]],<ref name="EAWGG" /> but inhospitable climate<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> that continually experienced storms<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|131|Jabiim}}</ref> that could interfere with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] devices.<ref name="Republic 55" /> The world also experienced torrential [[Water/Legends|rain]]<ref name="db" /> with less than five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] per [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] without precipitation.<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> The rain break lasted less than a [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hour]] according to the locals.<ref name="Republic 57" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Empire 29" /> the moisture that was left in the atmosphere had become terminally polluted, causing sporadic [[Electrical storm/Legends|storms of violent electricity]] and deadly [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]], which further hampered the use of repulsorlift vehicles, such as [[2-M Saber-class repulsor tank/Legends|2-M Saber-class repulsor tank]] and [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B repulsor tank]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> The air of [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] was drier and cleaner than the fetid air of Jabiim.<ref name="Empire 36" />

===Geography===
The surface of Jabiim was continually deluged by torrential rains<ref name="db" /> and constant drizzle,<ref name="GaW" /> and its muddy surfaces were unstable<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> and constantly shifted from the weight of the rains.<ref name="db" /> Any surface-based initiatives were complicated by the planet's perpetual storms.<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> These surfaces also hampered the effectiveness of the Republic AT-ATs, AT-TEs, and other armor.<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" />

Jabiim was susceptible to [[Groundquake/Legends|planet-quakes]],<ref name="Republic 55" /> and was also rich in [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> By the time of the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="Empire 29" /> however, its valuable ores were dwindling<ref name="Empire 29 Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-420/Star-Wars-Empire-29|text=Star Wars: Empire #29}}</ref> and the rain-soaked planet was becoming a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world, while its [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] and rivers ran black with ash and slag, due to the decades of Imperial strip mining. Huge digging and boring machines continued to cut ever deeper into the surface of the dying planet.<ref name="EAWGG" />

===Flora===
Jabiim's flora included [[Grass/Legends|grasses]], [[Tree/Legends|trees]],<ref name="Republic 56" /> and [[Bamboo/Legends|bamboo]].<ref name="EaW" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|But did they send ''aid'' during the Brainrot Plague? Did they ''react'' when the Trandoshans invaded? Where were the ''Jedi'' when Lythian pirates killed your parents … and mine?|Alto Stratus|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
[[File:Gwynhes-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|During the reign of Xim, Jabiim was known as Gwynhes Minor.]]
Between [[25,120 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], Jabiim was known as Gwynhes Minor and was situated in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] region, a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. During that time, Xim moved [[Gender/Legends|his]] forces from the Gwynhes system to Gwynhes Minor, and additionally the Tionese military advanced through Gwynhes Minor on its way from the Gwyhnes [[Star system/Legends|system]]—which would later be known as the Handooine system—to the Taskored system—the later [[Taskeed system/Legends|Taskeed system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Jabiim was considered as a potential location for one of the Lost Thrones of Xim.<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Jabiim system was the theater of a [[Operation Silent Roar|battle]] concluded with a Sith victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Jabiim Escort}}</ref>

Jabiim would later join the Galactic Republic around [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="Republic 55" /> During the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Jabiim (New Sith Wars)|battle]] won by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet suffered from an outbreak of [[Brainrot Plague]], which slammed the population of Jabiim. And prior to the Clone Wars, garrulous [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bandits [[Trandoshan invasion|attacked]] and conquered Jabiim's lands. After the bandits moved on, the [[Lythian pirates]] [[Lythian pirate raids|attacked]] the world, sieging small communities<ref name="db" /> and killing many.<ref name="Republic 55" /> Despite paying its due taxes to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and requesting aid, Jabiim received no help from the Republic in any of these cases.<ref name="db" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Main|Battle of Jabiim}}
{{Quote|In a battle between those fighting for a political principle, and those fighting for the survival of their home and family, the latter usually win in the long run. They've got nothing more to lose, and it makes them terrible enemies. Like us.|Jabiimi Nationalist commander, on the nature of fighting the Republic on Jabiim|<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:SWREP55-FC.jpg|thumb|left|300x330px|Obi-Wan Kenobi leads clone troopers into battle during their attack on Jabiim]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jabiim was a world that the Galactic Republic ignored until it was too late.<ref name="db" /> Because of the lack of assistance from the Senate, the [[Jabiim Congress]] sided with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] growing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> In fact, [[Alto Stratus]] had orchestrated a [[Political coup on Jabiim|coup]], killing most of the Loyalist members of Congress. A few of the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] who managed to escape the purge united under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orliss Gillmunn]].<ref name="Republic 55" />

Negotiations spearheaded by the [[Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps]] were rebuffed as Jabiim geared towards war. Rather than lose Jabiim and its valuable mines to the enemy, the Republic positioned their strike force on nearby Handooine for rapid deployment from there to Jabiim at a moment's notice. When the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] learned of the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] reports that the Congress had been supplied provisions, weapons, and credits to destroy the vocal loyalists by the Confederacy, they sought to extradite politically persecuted Loyalists and mineral resources that they owned.<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> Many in the Republic also believed Jabiim had been bought out by the CIS,<ref name="CSWE" /> with the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] believing that the "silver-tongued holocam-favorite" Alto Stratus was being deceived by the Separatists to seize more ore. At one point, a [[HoloNet News Core Edition]] report on the situation on Handooine and Jabiim was transmitted from the former planet's<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Jelwick]].<ref name="CSWE Jelwick">{{CSWECite|II|154|Jelwick}}</ref> General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had been assigned as theater commander for the campaign.<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> The [[HoloNet News/Legends|news]] report estimated that it was likely the invasion of Jabiim would occur within a [[Standard month/Legends|standard month]],<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> and the operation indeed began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

[[File:StrategicMudball-SWR55.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Anakin Skywalker during the Battle of Jabiim.]]
The Republic task force initially made significant gains and took dozen outposts, including three Separatist defensive positions—[[Camp Aurek/Legends|Camp Aurek]], [[Point Down]], and [[Outpost Shear]]—but overextended its limited resources, and the Confederates, led by Alto Stratus<ref name="Republic 55" /> and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> quickly gained the upper hand with a sudden [[Battle of Shelter Base|attack]] on the [[Shelter Base]], resulting in the loss of Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]].<ref name="Republic 55" /> At one point, a HoloNet News Core Edition report on the attack that was transmitted from the base communicated dozens of casualties and a possible loss of Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> Suffering heavy losses and pursued by the Separatists, the remaining Republic forces retreated to the southern hemisphere of the planet.<ref name="Republic 56" /> Only the valiant last stand of the "[[Padawan Pack]]" prevented a total rout by tying up large Separatist forces for several days in the battle of Cobalt Station, buying the remnants of the Republic task force enough time to evacuate off the planet.<ref name="Republic 57">[[Republic 57|''Republic'' 57]]</ref> The [[Battle of Jabiim|battle]] was a disaster for the Republic—the planet was lost to the Confederacy and due to the limited transports [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] chose to abandon Jabiim, leaving the Jabiimi Loyalists to their fate.<ref name="Republic 58" />

Angered by what he saw as betrayal, Captain Orliss Gillmunn rallied the surviving Loyalists and continued the fight. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> Orliss and [[Nolan Gillmunn]] planned an [[Battle of Hyber Canyon|attack]] on the droid command center in [[Hyber Canyon]].<ref name="Empire 32" /> Olriss was stabbed to death with a blade by the Jabiimi Nationalist [[Thorne Kraym]] during a [[massacre at High Rock Canyon]]. However, Nolan himself survived.<ref name="Empire 33">[[Empire 33|''Empire'' 33]]</ref>

During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], the Republic came back and attempted to take back the planet. The [[Battle at Jabiim (Outer Rim Sieges)|battle]] resulted in a costly Galactic Republic victory, but, along with the battles of [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Felucia]], and [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Boz Pity]], led to the fall of the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]], an area known to house numerous Separatist industrial worlds.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The [[Jabiimi Nationalists]] eventually allied themselves to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; however, Jabiimi Loyalists carried the struggle for independence but didn't manage to repel the Imperial forces.<ref name="Empire 29" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|We've spent last two decades fighting to win back our freedom. We're closer than we've ever been, but… we do need help. We've let the past turn us into isolationists.|Nolan Gillmunn|<ref name="Empire 29" />}}
[[File:The_Rebel_Fortress.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] attacking the rebel base.]]
Jabiim was the target of an Imperial assault. After a [[Skirmish on Carida|failed Rebel raid]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], Imperial leaders decided that Jabiim was the most likely planet as a launching point of the raid. Darth Vader led an Imperial fleet to wipe out the Rebels on the planet. The [[Battle at Jabiim|attack]] resulted in Vader not only succeeding in taking control of the planet, but also learning the location of [[Kalast]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who had sided with the Rebels.<ref name="EaW" />

Years later, Jabiim's ore supplies had been diminished because of Imperial over-mining.<ref name="Empire 29" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was not willing to pull the last of his troopers off Jabiim,<ref name="Empire 29 Dark Horse" /> despite the repeated harassment of the local Jabiimi rebels, which had persisted for 19 years.<ref name="Empire 29" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] dispatched a task force lead by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to support the Jabiimi. Though as Luke set foot on the planet, he realized that he had stepped into his father's shadow. As a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Anakin Skywalker had served on Jabiim, and the locals did not forget or forgive.<ref name="Empire 29">[[Empire 29|''Empire'' 29]]</ref>

[[File:SecondbattleJabiim2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Imperial forces invading Jabiim's surface.]]
Later, the Empire launched a [[Subjugation of Jabiim|second invasion of Jabiim]]. With superior technology, the Imperials won the battle and crushed the rebellion. However, the Empire also made a deal with a group of wealthy Jabiimi: in exchange for their own freedom, they would give the rest of the planet's population to the Imperials as slaves.<ref name="Empire 32" />

[[File:SWEMP36-FC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Jabiimi's last stand, the Empire's final assault]]
What would complicate things further, was the fact that Darth Vader himself was present in orbit above the planet. Haunted by the memories of his former life, he ordered a full-scale decimation of the planet, destroying all life on its surface with the excuse that the Alliance would thus be deprived of a potential ally.<ref name="Empire 33" /> In the ensuing chaos, the rebel groups managed to escape and kill their Jabiimi captors, with the Jabiim faction fleeing towards the nearest mines, now their only means of escaping the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|planetary bombardment]].<ref name="Empire 34">[[Empire 34|''Empire'' 34]]</ref>

Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the beginning of the bombardment, the last mine-turned-fortress would fall to an Imperial ground force led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]], and the survivors were led to an awaiting [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|slave-transport]] and shipped out to [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]].<ref name="Empire 36">[[Empire 36|''Empire'' 36]]</ref>

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], it was believed by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] that Jabiim would join with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]].<ref name="Blooodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
